text: A promising young disciple kneels before you and begs to be taken as your student.

outcomes.text: Teaching sharpens your own understanding. Your student's progress brings you merit.
The student passes every test and earns your respect.
The student quits in anger. A lesson for you too.
You send them to someone else.

text: The sect opens a secret realm once every few decades, and only a few places are given out.

outcomes.text: The realm's treasures reward your boldness.
The realm's trials are cruel. You return injured but alive.

choices.label: Give your place to a junior disciple

outcomes.text: The junior is overjoyed, and your generosity is noted.

text: You discover that a senior in your sect has been skimming from the treasury.

outcomes.text: The senior has friends. Your report is quietly buried, and so are you, for a while.
The senior pays up and promises to be careful.
The senior reports YOU. It takes months to clear your name.
It is not your business. Probably.

text: The alchemy hall holds an open examination, and winners earn a place at the great cauldron.

outcomes.text: You place near the top, and a master presses a few pills into your hands.
You place in the middle. A hard-earned lesson in humility.

text: The ancestral hall opens its doors to those with enough merit. Portraits of the founders gaze down at you.

outcomes.text: A founder's lingering will blesses you with a gift of qi and clarity.
You leave incense and a quiet prayer.
Behind a founder's portrait hides a forgotten scripture.
The founders' spirits do not appreciate the intrusion.
